summary: Added the generic corroborated-cancelled-duplicate-fetch category: types plus the shared rule string in witness-real-app.ts, a synchronous request-outcome ledger in playwright-host.ts, and buildCancelledDuplicateFetchInventory in real-app-run.ts. Pinned by path+method+reason, never count; admission requires a 2xx sibling fetch by the same page, otherwise it throws. All other failures still fail exactly as before. Published factoriolab receipts twice, both green: behavior parity digest identical across all 8 runs while the race fired in different runs (1,1,0,1 vs 1,1,1,0), proving the mechanism makes publishing deterministic. 29 new tests (13 CLI mechanism, 16 core schema). All five verify commands pass; 992/992.
open_questions: Observed instances are deliberately excluded from the lane-parity behavior digest (category, rule and membership do participate); flagging for Judge as the one judgement call in the mechanism.
Receipt canonicalDigest differs between publishes by design, since each receipt records its own runs' observed instances; behavior parity digest is stable.
